snippet.title: MR. RECORDS Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3053470/MR_RECORDS/

Rhythm platformer MR. RECORDS received a new trailer during the Future Games Show at gamescom, drawing us into its mesmerising cartoon world. It's coming soon to PC & Nintendo Switch 2.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
